title: Argos Black Friday 2026: dates, best deals and what to expect
description: Argos Black Friday 2026 is live from 30 October to 1 December. How the price guarantee works, Christmas returns and this week's best deals.
intro:
**The Argos Black Friday 2026 sale is live: it started on Friday 30 October and runs until Tuesday 1 December.** It opened with around 1,800 products, and last year it grew to about 10,000 by the week of Black Friday, so expect more deals to arrive through November.

The best buys this week are kitchen gadgets, beauty gifts and toys: the Ninja SLUSHi Max is £259.99, below any price we've seen tracked for it, the ghd Gold gift bundle is £159 and Magna-Tiles are at their lowest recorded price. Badged deals also carry a price guarantee until Christmas Day. Last checked: 12 November 2026.

body:
## When does Argos Black Friday 2026 start and end?

Argos's own price guarantee terms confirm that **Black Friday at Argos runs from 30 October to 1 December 2026**. That's a day earlier than 2025 (31 October) and two days earlier than 2024 (1 November). Argos hasn't published a weekly drop schedule this year, but in past years it added new deals through the month, with the biggest cuts in the week of Black Friday (27 November) and over Cyber Monday (30 November). See our [when is Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) for every retailer's dates.

## What's in the Argos sale so far

The first wave covers TVs, headphones and smartwatches, PS5 and Switch 2 bundles, Lego, vacuums, coffee machines and beauty electricals from Shark, BaByliss, Remington, Oral-B and Philips. Prices move around, too: the Dyson V8 Cyclone (2026), £209.99 in early November, was back to £350 on 12 November, and the £99.99 Ninja AF170UK deal has ended. Two things to watch:

- **Check the 'was' price.** Some Argos 'was' prices are higher than anything the product has really sold for recently. Bluey's Big Shopping Day playset, 'was £75', is one we couldn't verify.
- **Compare with Amazon.** In our 1 November check, the Kenwood kMix (£180) and the Ninja Double Stack (£169.99) were the same price at both, and the Russell Hobbs Steam Genie was cheaper at Amazon.

Our [Lego Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/) shows the prices to aim for on sets, and the [Ninja](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/), [Shark](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/) and [Dyson](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/) guides cover the brands Argos usually discounts most.

## Argos Black Friday toy offers

Argos's toy offers are live (checked 9 November), with up to 50% off selected toys, extra savings on some lines with the codes TOYS25 and TOYS50, multi-buys including 3 for £20, 2 for £15, 2 for £20 and 2 for £30, and up to a third off selected LEGO. There's no '3 for 2' across all toys this year. Our [Christmas toy deals 2026 spotlight](/spotlight/christmas-toy-deals-2026/) has the toys worth buying now, and [Christmas gifts for kids under £20](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-kids-under-20/) picks the best cheap ones.

## Argos's Black Friday Price Guarantee

The guarantee is back for 2026. Products with the **Price Guarantee** badge won't drop in price before midnight on 25 December. If the displayed price does fall, Argos emails you a voucher for the difference as an Argos e-gift card, valid for three months. The main conditions:

- Only badged products count, and 'A-mazing deals' items are excluded.
- It covers Argos's own displayed price, not discount codes, and not cheaper prices at other shops.
- You need to give a valid email address when you buy, online or in store.

It makes buying badged items early in November low-risk, as long as you're happy with a gift card rather than cash.

## Christmas returns

Argos has confirmed its 2026 Christmas returns policy. **Anything bought between 23 September and 25 December 2026 can be returned until 31 January 2027**, as long as it's unused and in its original packaging. That makes Argos a safe place to buy presents early.

## Nectar points and delivery

You earn 1 Nectar point per £1 spent at Argos, and 500 points are worth £2.50 off. Sainsbury's has agreed to sell Argos, but the deal isn't due to complete until early 2027, and Nectar will carry on at Argos afterwards.

Fast Track same-day delivery costs £7.95. Standard delivery is £4.95 for small items, free on orders over £100. Click & Collect orders are held for seven days.

## What was cheap at Argos last Black Friday

These 2025 Black Friday prices are a good guide to what to expect:

- Kenwood kMix stand mixer: £180 (back to that price on 1 November)
- Lego Technic Ferrari SF-24: £149 (was £200)
- Amazon Fire HD 8 tablet: £39.99 (was £99.99)
- Russell Hobbs Worcester kettle: £22.50 (was £45)
- PS5 Slim: £379.99 (was £479.99)
- MacBook Air 13in M2: £699 (was £999)

Argos's strongest categories are small kitchen appliances, vacuums, toys and Amazon devices.

## Is Argos cheaper than Amazon?

Often it's the same. During Black Friday the two tend to match each other, so check both before you buy. Argos wins on same-day collection, its price guarantee and its long Christmas returns window. Amazon's own Black Friday Week runs from 19 to 30 November, with its device deals from 16 November; see our [Amazon Black Friday guide](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/).

### When does the Argos Black Friday sale start in 2026?

It's already on. The Argos Black Friday sale started on 30 October 2026 and runs until 1 December 2026.

### Does Argos do a Black Friday price guarantee?

Yes. If a product with the Price Guarantee badge drops in price at Argos before midnight on 25 December 2026, you get the difference back as an Argos e-gift card.

### Can I return Argos Christmas presents in January?

Yes. Items bought from 23 September to 25 December 2026 can be returned until 31 January 2027, if they're unused and in their original packaging.

### Are Argos Black Friday deals worth it?

Many are, especially on small appliances, toys and Lego. But some 'deals' are prices you'll also see at other times. Compare with Amazon and check the target prices in our [Black Friday guides](/black-friday/) before buying.
